node.title: XR rank-two trades are proper subcircuits of official Maxwell cores
node.statement: Embed any of the five rank-two support profiles into full official Maxwell blocks. Charging every coordinate saved beyond private placement to newly consumed pair-intersection slack gives exact lower bounds on Delta_J=2|union J|-8-c|J|. Across P-A block types (m,c)=(9,5),(7,3) and P-B one-loop types (10,6),(8,4), the minimum is Delta_J=2 and all twenty profile bounds are explicit and set-system sharp. The full Maxwell core has deficit -e<=0, so a rank-two relation can never activate every block. Hence every rank-two anomaly is a proper local subcircuit, while every full-block-support anomaly has trade rank at least three. This is a circuit split, not a payment of the local branch.
